body: **Foco:** Comunicação integrada: Análises.
**Phrasal verbs:** scale back.
**Pronúncia:** Expressividade.
**22 palavras novas** (análises).
**Texto do dia:** poema, haiku ou letra.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo integrar leitura, escuta, fala e escrita sobre análise e usar o phrasal verb scale back.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Scaling Back
lines: Had I known the weight of all my plans,
I would have carried less across the years.
If I were wiser now, I’d scale back the demands
and trade the endless lists for quiet ears.
What accounts for all this haste, this daily race?
No model can explain the reasons why.
Still, if I scale back and slow my pace,
I may see more of earth, and more of sky.

items.q: The speaker wants to take on more demands.
The speaker wonders what accounts for the haste.
items.why: What accounts for all this haste.

items.q: The poem says a model can explain everything.

blocks.body: **scale back** é separável: *scale back the plan* / *scale the plan back* / *scale it back* (✗ *scale back it*). Sinônimos: **cut back, reduce, downsize**.

items.s: We need to ___ back our plans. (scale)
If I were wiser, I ___ scale back the demands. (would)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Could I scale it back even more
To reduce your demands and slow down

body: **Slow down and smell the roses** — Desacelerar e curtir a vida
**Bite off more than one can chew** — Dar um passo maior que a perna
**Cut back on…** — Reduzir…
**Take a step back** — Dar um passo atrás
**Burn the candle at both ends** — Acender a vela dos dois lados
**Take one’s foot off the pedal** — Tirar o pé do acelerador
**Less haste, more speed** — Devagar se vai ao longe
**Make time for…** — Arranjar tempo para…
**To reduce your demands and slow down.** — Reduzir suas exigências e desacelerar.
**Could I scale it back even more?** — Posso reduzir ainda mais?
**What does “scale back” mean in my poem?** — O que “scale back” significa no meu poema?

rows: We scaled back production. — Reduzimos a produção.

items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido; o ritmo do inglês se apoia nas sílabas fortes, e as fracas se encolhem.

prompts.q: Say what you would scale back.
prompts.model: I would scale back my working hours.

prompts.q: Make a mixed conditional about haste.
prompts.model: If I had slowed down, I would be calmer now.
Stress accounts for most of my headaches.

blocks.task: Write a 4-line poem or 5 sentences about slowing down, using scale back and one conditional.
blocks.model: If I had scaled back my plans, I would be calmer now. I will scale back the lists and keep the sky. Stress accounts for most of my days. No model can explain why we hurry. I want to walk, not run.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
